termination_contract.normal: Completed DSH session -> trusted candidate export -> independent custom training verifier; binary reward only for completed evaluated candidates.
termination_contract.truncated: Truncated/budget/invalid token trajectories retain evidence and fail without training reward; no silent drop/zero reward.
termination_contract.infrastructure: Model/process/verifier infrastructure failure aborts bounded trajectory without reward; candidate edit-policy violations are separately explicit reward=0.
termination_contract.cleanup: finally close DSH session, release owned environment, cancel in-flight requests; trainer owns vLLM sleep/wake; only terminate owned services

record_required: reward and independent training verifier report
input/output token counts and elapsed time

future_budgets.enforcement: Implemented admission/token/time limits and process-wide file lease; CPU request rejection and verifier timeout checked; full real GPU lifecycle unverified.

integration_preference.inference_compatibility: DSH already interoperates with vLLM through its native OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions API; project real smoke passed on 0.19.1.
integration_preference.first_choice: Implemented native HTTP/rLLM gateway + registered verl AgentLoop with durable session evidence and custom restricted training verifier; real DSH scripted CPU check passed.
integration_preference.custom_model_bridge: Not the default. Consider only after demonstrating a concrete training-interface gap; reuse upstream parsing/SSE rather than rebuilding the inference protocol.
